confirm.title: Danfoss Eco thermostat found
confirm.description: A Danfoss Eco radiator thermostat ({address}) was discovered nearby. Do you want to set it up?

pair.title: Pair with the thermostat
pair.description:
Go to the radiator ({address}) and SHORT-PRESS the timer (clock) button on the thermostat, then immediately click SUBMIT below.

Tip: keep pressing the button every ~10 seconds while pairing — the window the device opens is short. No PIN, MAC or key entry is needed; the key is read automatically.

manual_key.title: Enter secret key manually
manual_key.description: If you already know this thermostat's 32-character secret key (e.g. from etrv2mqtt or libetrv), paste it here.

menu_options.pair: Pair automatically (press the button on the thermostat)

manual.title: Add a thermostat manually
manual.description: Enter the thermostat's Bluetooth address and its 32-character secret key. Use this for a device that isn't advertising right now, or to reuse a key from etrv2mqtt / libetrv.

reconfigure.title: Update secret key / PIN
reconfigure.description: Update the stored secret key or PIN for {address}. Leave the key as-is to change only the PIN.

no_devices.title: No thermostat detected
no_devices.description:
No Danfoss Eco thermostat was found nearby yet.

Walk to the radiator and press the button on the thermostat to wake it, make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range, then choose Search again. Manual entry is only needed if the device can't be detected.

error.button_not_pressed: The pairing window was not open. Short-press the timer button on the thermostat and click Submit again right away.
error.not_in_range: The thermostat is not seen by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Move a proxy closer or check the batteries.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the thermostat. Make sure it is in range and try again.
error.invalid_key: The key must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_address: The Bluetooth address must look like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.no_devices_found: No Danfoss Eco thermostats were discovered. Make sure a Bluetooth adapter or proxy is in range.

data.cache_ttl_hours: Keep the last reading for (hours, 0 = forever)

sync_time.name: Sync time
sync_time.description: Writes the current local time to the thermostat (fixes the E10 error).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Danfoss Eco device to sync.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Programs the vacation period and temperature.

set_schedule.name: Set weekly schedule
set_schedule.description: Writes the comfort/setback temperatures and/or the weekly program to the device.

days.name: Days
days.description: 7 lists (Mon..Sun) of 'HH:MM' transition times; before the first time each day the device is in setback.
